title: Login with valid credentials
steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Enter username 'standard_user'
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'
4. Click Login button
expected_result: User redirected to inventory page and URL contains 'inventory.html'

title: Login button enabled when both fields filled
steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Enter username 'standard_user'
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'
4. Observe Login button state
expected_result: Login button is active and clickable

title: Successful login displays product catalog
steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Enter username 'standard_user'
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'
4. Click Login button
expected_result: Inventory page displays product items with names prices and images

title: Successful logout after login
preconditions: User is logged in with standard_user
steps:
1. Click side menu button
2. Click Logout link
expected_result: User redirected to login page and URL contains 'index.html'

title: Login maintains session after page refresh
preconditions: User is logged in with standard_user
expected_result: User remains on inventory page and session is preserved
